patch.description: Current-main integration packet: docs/planning/UIQ-03-INTEGRATION-ADMISSION.md. Mount the accepted native guidance/journey presentation inside the existing Design readiness disclosure; preserve journey navigation, correction behavior and legacy checklist fallback.
patch.expectation: Clearly distinguish user-confirmed fit intent from digital validity; show readiness/blocker/guidance honestly, route explicit correction requests to existing controls, and never change engine decisions or infer physical fit.
acceptanceCriteria: Accepted candidate source, CSS and tests match the immutable exit manifest and remain byte-identical.
Embedded uiq_guidance default, local override, stale/unknown fail-safe and exact legacy checklist fallback are tested.
Existing journey navigation, validation, blockers, guidance actions, saved data and exports remain unchanged; fit intent is shown only after explicit Style review.
Changed production code and the settled repository pass 100% statement/branch/function/line coverage, build/typecheck, operational and export-byte-identity gates.
Actual rendered desktop/narrow/zoom, accessibility/media, no-egress, fallback and required packaged behavior are inspected and recorded.
Codex reviews/merges the PR; Slice 737 verifies main deployment and closes the canonical board. UIQ-04/05/07 stay Backlog.
